newsitem.title: USA: Seitel to post record Q3 revs, Q4 "strong".
newsitem.headline: Seitel to post record Q3 revs, Q4 "strong".

text.p: Seitel Inc said Thursday it has achieved record revenue in this third quarter that is significantly above the year-ago revenue of $17.9 million.
Growth is being spurred by seismic and oil and gas sales, and the fourth quarter outlook looks "very strong," the company said.
"The outlook for the fourth quarter is very strong," company Chief Executive Paul Frame stated.
The company, which sells seismic technology to petroleum companies, said it had nine-month revenue of $56.6 million, the record for the first three quarters until now.
In the year-ago nine-month period the company reported revenue of $47.5 million. Year-ago fourth quarter figures were $0.02 per share earnings on revenues of $17.8 million.
The company said it will report third quarter revenues in mid-October and earnings in early November.
